rules.rule: Full-width card feed with avatar, username, timestamp, content, and reaction row. Cards should have 8dp corner radius, subtle shadow, 16dp horizontal padding.
Engagement elements (like, comment, share) must be immediately visible below content — not hidden. Use icon + count pairs, minimum 44dp tap target.
Expressive, vibrant color palette. Primary color should be bold and brand-defining. Use color for actions and highlights, not for backgrounds.
Stories row at top of feed: circular avatars with colorful border ring, 60x60dp, horizontal scroll, + add button as first item.
Profile: large cover photo or gradient header, circular avatar overlapping, follower/following/post counts horizontally displayed, bio below.
